thread:
priya: Quick sync proposal 3 consolidate cloud marketplace ref-archs into a single refkit-starter repo. One umbrella, provider adapters, consistent Terraform patterns. Faster partner enablement and clearer support path. Thoughts?

devon: +1. Main engineering concerns: API parity across modules and CI matrix for providers/TF versions.

kevin: Agreed. We should add a packaging adapter per cloud that emits provider-specific artifacts and metadata. I can prototype a GH Actions job for that.

elaine: Partnerships wants one-click deploy examples and an opinionated secure network layout for enterprise customers. Also include GPU SKU guidance and cost notes.

priya: Draft plan: repo layout + naming, common module spec (vars/outputs), lightweight smoke tests, publishing pipeline, partner onboarding doc.

devon: For common spec propose minimal inputs: name, region, instance_type, node_count, network_subnet_id, tags. Outputs: lb_dns, instance_ids, module_version. Defaults where reasonable.

kevin: Packaging detail: AWS needs CloudFormation/AMI or SaaS listing artifacts; Azure wants managed image + listing metadata; GCP needs marketplace metadata + deployment configs. We'll keep adapters small.

elaine: Add ONBOARDING.md with checklist: security review, sample deploy, billing SKUs, support contacts, marketing blurb. Helps PS and partner managers.

priya: Example snippet to include in README:

```
module "refkit_inference" {
  source = "github.com/redwood-inference/refkit-starter//modules/aws/inference"
  name = "refkit-dev"
  region = "us-west-2"
  instance_type = "g4dn.xlarge"
  node_count = 2
}
```

elaine: Include a CPU-only sample and cost caveats for evals.

devon: CI matrix: terraform fmt/check, tflint, terratest smoke (small instance), metadata validation. Matrix across providers and TF versions. Gate PRs for affected providers.

kevin: I'll draft ci/matrix.yml and ci/publish.yml and a metadata generator script.

opsbot: CI created: refkit-starter/ci/matrix queued.

priya: Timeline: RFC + repo skeleton by EOD Fri (devon), CI & packaging draft by Wed (kevin), partner docs + onboarding by next Fri (elaine).

elaine: I'll start the onboarding checklist and partner email templates. Will tag GTM when RFC is up. @here :thumbsup: 

devon: I'll open the RFC PR with skeleton (modules/aws, modules/azure, modules/gcp, examples/, ci/).

kevin: Following up with the GH Actions draft and sample metadata output.

priya: Action items recap:
- devon: RFC + skeleton (EOD Fri)
- kevin: CI + packaging draft (Wed)
- elaine: partner docs + onboarding (next Fri)
- all: review RFC PR

elaine: tagging partner-engineering when PR is up.

priya: Thanks everyone 3 feels like good momentum. We'll prepare a one-pager for execs after skeleton + CI demo.
